title: The Story of God with Morgan Freeman
text: The lab's brain-imaging research with incarcerated youth was featured in the segment “Studying Kids Who Kill” of Morgan Freeman's National Geographic Channel series.

title: Brains on Trial with Alan Alda
text: Alan Alda's two-part PBS series on neuroscience in the courtroom covered the lab's work on predicting reoffending from brain scans. Dr. Kiehl also joined the companion panel Alda moderated at the World Science Festival.

title: “Suffering Souls” in The New Yorker
text: John Seabrook's ten-page feature in The New Yorker on Dr. Kiehl and the laboratory's work studying psychopathy in prisons.

title: Keynote at CrimeCon 2026
art_sub: Inside the mind of a psychopath
art_meta: CrimeCon 2026 · May 30 · Caesars Palace, Las Vegas
text: “What makes them tick? Inside the mind of a psychopath.” Dr. Kiehl's invited keynote at Caesars Palace, to a conference of about 6,000 people.

title: Robert D. Hare Lifetime Achievement Award
art_meta: Society for the Scientific Study of Psychopathy
text: In 2026 Dr. Kiehl received the highest honor of the Society for the Scientific Study of Psychopathy, named for his doctoral mentor.

title: The Psychopath Whisperer
text: The science of those without conscience, written for general readers. Published in North America and the United Kingdom and translated into seven languages.
